culture.text: A huge company of about 95,288 people on LinkedIn, mostly from computer science, electrical engineering and IT.
Its guiding principles are 'Think really big, Play to win, Drive durable growth', and it describes a culture of trust, learning and collaboration.

open.text: Cisco Netherlands B.V. and Cisco Systems International B.V. are both IND recognised sponsors.
Top schools of staff include BITS Pilani, Visvesvaraya Technological University and University of Mumbai alongside US universities.

growth.text: Staff grew from 75,900 in 2019 to 86,200 in 2025.
Revenue was USD 56.654 billion in 2024, with a net profit of USD 10.18 billion.

worth_knowing.text: Cisco was accused of fostering a hostile workplace for Muslim and Arab employees.
Its CEO warned staff worried about AI-driven change that 'nothing's going to feel good right now'.
Several Cisco security products had critical flaws exploited by attackers in September 2026.
